title: Refuse a work handoff offer whose target the intended session cannot accept, instead of leaving a visible but unacceptable offer
outcome: Refuse a work handoff offer whose target the intended session cannot accept, instead of leaving a visible but unacceptable offer
acceptance: An offer addressed to a target that does not resolve to an Engram session principal able to accept it is refused at offer time with a message naming the expected target form
When an offer is visible to a session, accept from that session either succeeds or names exactly why that session is not the offer's target
A test reproduces the 2026-11-13 case (offer addressed to a TermAl host-qualified session id) and proves both behaviours
